notes: Aggregate integration failure in `db_integration_test` was caused by `tools/clean_test_db.py` deleting `schema_migrations` rows while leaving the migrated schema in place, so `TestHarness.runMigrations` replayed DDL into existing tables and returned `error.ServerError`.
The previously reported OIDC-10 aggregate blocker no longer reproduced once aggregate integration was rerun after the DB cleanup issue was isolated.

Focused OIDC-31 remained blocked after Keycloak/backend startup because `src/main.zig` crashed on the first `/health/live` request while parsing `request.head.target` after the request body had already been consumed.
Live Keycloak and backend prerequisites were absent at handoff start and had to be brought up locally for the focused OIDC-31 validation path.

fixes: Removed `schema_migrations` from the cleanup table list in `tools/clean_test_db.py` so integration cleanup preserves migration state.
Moved request body reading in `src/main.zig` to after request-target parsing so borrowed request metadata stays valid during path handling.
Started local Keycloak via `docker-compose up -d keycloak` and validated backend health/runtime before rerunning the live OIDC-31 preflight.
